findings.reason: §14's done-when ("scored FacilityPath rows under each of the three trees") rests on this mechanism, so the section must name the re-seed/re-expansion path (or a reset scope) that actually creates rows for trees with none, or be re-scoped to a mechanism that does.
findings.text: §14 is built on a mechanism that does not do what the section claims: it runs `discover paths jt-60sa` "scoped to /analysis/src with the existing scoping option" to create FacilityPath rows for `/analysis/src/client_eqdbms.EQ32.Rev1`, `/analysis/src/SAeqfame` and `/analysis/src/SAeqread`, but the only scoping option on that command is `--root` (imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:20), whose value becomes `root_filter` and is applied solely as `AND any(root IN $root_filter WHERE p.path STARTS WITH root)` when claiming paths (parallel.py:483, :539, :596) — a filter over already-existing FacilityPath rows. `/analysis/src` is already a configured discovery root (imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml:139), so the walk that would create those rows has already run; with the frontier at 0 and no `--reset-to`/re-expansion named, re-running the command rescans nothing and creates no rows, and a parent at a terminal status is not re-enumerated by `claim_paths_for_expanding` (parallel.py:523, which claims only `status = triaged`). The plan therefore states a discovery mechanism that may produce zero new rows for the trees the section exists to reach.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; the landed sections consolidate many query sites onto single owners (`build_vector_search` in imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py, `GraphClient.ensure_vector_indexes`, `pending_embed_predicate` in imas_codex/discovery/base/embed_worker.py) and §19 adds one small fragment helper rather than a spread of wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §19 names the owner to extend, `ingest_files` in imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py (its `MERGE (e)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(c)` at line 522, called from imas_codex/discovery/code/workers.py:836), and explicitly adds no second link pass.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §19 states "Interface budget: nothing added" and §14 reuses the existing `--root` and `--path-prefix` options rather than adding surface.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §14 proposes to discover three trees that have no FacilityPath rows by running `discover paths jt-60sa` scoped with `--root`, but `--root` is only a claim filter over existing rows (imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:483) and no re-seed or reset is named, so a completed walk will not create the missing rows.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §19's fragment helper extends the two existing inline `coalesce(ce.source_file, cc.source_file)` sites (imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:483 and imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1659) and repairs the buggy third, so it replaces copies rather than paralleling machinery.
